entries.adaptation: Add explicit work/parts C exports. After the same independent frontend pipeline, externalize request as host_request exactly as the legacy fixture; optional Cell[Any] anchor enables the cycle collector. Managed variant applies the original two String substitutions. C symbols alone are adapted.
observations: Both GC modes, old 4096-byte heap/32-byte String/48 frames of 2048 bytes/2 Deferred/2 task and event slots.
1000 outer iterations including 1000 child rounds in the first; result 2*count+2, first failure 11, last failure 6, cancellation/discarded output unchanged.
At most 3 live child records while running, 2 between requests; no children or allocated heap after release.
Typed error contains a NUL-bearing borrowed String and List[String]; release poisons input and drops the List owner.
Managed success producer supplies borrowed String 42; queued producer/context release runs once outside ISR and event lock, cancelled queued completion releases without producing.
Late task completions fail and returned values survive frame/scope reuse.
